backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the NFT marketplace backend with collections, NFT items, user profiles, and minting logic, using role-based access control (admin/user) and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing three implemented features related to fixing the perpetually-loading Admin button: actor readiness checks, timeout-based admin detection, and Navigation component updates to hide the button on error/timeout.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON summary document describing the purpose and key changes of each frontend source file for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including colors for background, foreground, sidebar, charts, and UI components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Istvan Seidel light art portfolio app, setting German language, viewport meta, SEO description, and mounting the React app at `#root`.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (gallery, NFT detail, admin, blog, upload, contact) and wraps the app in a dark-default ThemeProvider.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionF: Form component for creating or editing NFT collections in the admin dashboard, using `useCreateCollection` and `useUpdateCollection` hooks with German-language labels and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionL: Displays a list of NFT collections with edit and delete actions, using a confirmation dialog before deletion and a modal dialog for editing via AdminCollectionForm.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing an NFT item, handling image upload with preview/progress, collection selection, price input, and submitting via create/update hooks.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTList.tsx: Renders a list of all NFTs with thumbnail, collection name, price badge, and per-item edit/delete actions including a confirmation dialog before deletion.
frontend/src/components/ArtworkCard.tsx: Presentational card component that displays a legacy artwork's image, title, and description with hover scale and overlay effects.
frontend/src/components/IssuedNFTCard.ts: Card component for a minted on-chain NFT showing its image, token ID, mint date, owner principal, and optional 'Mein NFT' highlight badge when owned by the current user.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component providing a sticky header with logo, navigation, and login button, a main content slot, and a footer with copyright and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing a spinner during authentication and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/MintNFTModal.tsx: A modal dialog component for minting NFTs on ICP, handling image upload (with drag-and-drop), title/description input, upload progress, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Top navigation bar component with route-aware buttons for main pages, an authenticated-only upload button, and a timeout-aware admin button with retry affordance.
frontend/src/components/NFTBadge.tsx: A small badge component that displays a sparkle icon and 'NFT' label using the primary color scheme.
frontend/src/components/NFTCard.tsx: A card component that displays an NFT's image, title, collection name, price in ICP, and an optional link to the ICP explorer.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionCar: A clickable card component that links to an NFT collection on an external marketplace, showing a cover image with loading/error states, title, description, and a 'buy and trade' label.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionsSe: A section component that renders a static grid of seven NFT collection cards (Getgems/TON blockchain) with titles, descriptions, and preview images.
frontend/src/components/NFTDetailModal.t: A detail modal that shows a full NFT's image, metadata (title, description, token ID, mint date, owner, price), copyable fields, and an ICP explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTExplanation.t: An informational section with cards explaining NFT concepts, automatic minting on ICP, and the ICP architecture to educate users about the technology.
frontend/src/components/NFTInfo.tsx: React component that displays NFT metadata (token ID, mint date, price) with formatted values and a link to the ICP Explorer dashboard.
frontend/src/components/PrincipalDisplay: Reusable component that displays an ICP principal address (optionally shortened) with a tooltip showing the full value and a copy-to-clipboard button.
frontend/src/data/lightHealthBlogPosts.t: Static dataset of German-language blog posts about light health topics (wavelengths, blue light effects, red light therapy), typed as StaticBlogPost with bigint timestamps.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, initializing access control with an optional admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorReady.ts: Hook that wraps useActor to expose an isActorReady boolean and actorError state, with a 15-second timeout and reset logic tied to identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateBlogPost.ts: Stub mutation hook for blog post creation that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been removed in favor of the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCollection.t: Mutation hook that calls actor.addCollection to create a new NFT collection and invalidates the nft-collections query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateNFT.ts: Mutation hook that uploads a new NFT via actor.addNFT, fetches the created item, handles authorization errors with user-friendly messages, and invalidates nft-items on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCollection.t: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT collection by ID and invalidates both nft-collections and nft-items queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteNFT.ts: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT by ID via the actor and invalidates the nft-items query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllArtworks.ts: Legacy hook stub that returns an empty array for artworks, preserving the LegacyArtwork interface while the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllBlogPosts.ts: Legacy hook stub that returns an empty array for backend blog posts, allowing static blog posts to still render after the old blog backend was replaced.
Query hook that fetches all NFT collections from the actor, gating execution until the actor is ready and merging actor-fetching state into isLoading.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllIssuedNFTs.t: Query hook that fetches all issued NFTs via actor.listAllNFTs, enabled only when the actor is ready, with a 30-second stale time.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllNFTs.ts: React Query hook that fetches all NFT items from the backend actor, returning loading state combined with actor fetching state.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtwork.ts: Stub hook replacing the old artwork backend; always returns null since artworks have been superseded by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtworksByCateg: Stub hook replacing the old category-based artwork backend; always returns an empty array.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetBlogPost.ts: Stub hook replacing the old blog backend; always returns null so static blog posts are used instead.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook that fetches the authenticated caller's user profile from the backend, enabled only when the user is logged in and the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetMyIssuedNFTs.ts: React Query hook that fetches the authenticated user's issued NFTs via the actor's listMyNFTs method.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFT.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single NFT item by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFTsByCollectio: React Query hook that fetches all NFT items belonging to a specific collection ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider context and useInternetIdentity hook for managing Internet Computer authentication via AuthClient, including login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: React Query hook that checks whether the authenticated caller has admin privileges, with timeout, retry logic, and combined loading/error state from actor and identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdminWithT: Stateful hook that checks admin status with a phase-based state machine and configurable timeout, handling actor readiness, retries, and identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useMintNFT.ts: Mutation hook that mints a new NFT via the backend actor and invalidates relevant query caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: Mutation hook that saves the caller's user profile to the backend and invalidates the currentUserProfile query on success.
Stub mutation hook replacing the old contact form backend; always throws an error indicating the feature is unavailable.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCollection.t: Mutation hook that updates a collection's name and description via the backend actor and invalidates the collections query cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateNFT.ts: Mutation hook that updates an NFT's metadata and image via the backend actor and invalidates the NFT items query cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadArtwork.ts: Stub mutation hook replacing the old artwork upload backend; always throws an error directing users to the new NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadImage.ts: Hook that uploads an image file to the backend actor with progress tracking, format validation, and auth error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for a warm art-themed light and dark color palette, including sidebar and chart variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that checks authentication and admin status (with timeout handling for IC cold starts), then renders tabbed views for managing NFT collections and individual NFTs.
frontend/src/pages/ArtworkDetail.tsx: Placeholder artwork detail page that displays a 'not found' message, as the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/pages/Blog.tsx: Blog listing page that merges static and backend blog posts, displays them as clickable cards, and shows a 'New Post' button for authenticated admins.
frontend/src/pages/BlogCreate.tsx: Admin-only form page for creating new blog posts with title, content, and optional featured image upload, redirecting non-admins back to the blog.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPost.tsx: Individual blog post detail page that fetches a post by ID from the backend or falls back to static data, displaying the title, date, featured image, and content.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact form page with name, email, subject, and message fields that submits via a mutation hook and shows success or error alerts.
frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx: Public gallery page displaying a hero banner, a static Walter Russell quote, and NFT collections with loading skeletons and error handling via refetch buttons.
frontend/src/pages/NFTDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single NFT showing its image, title, description, collection badge, price, and a link to the ICP dashboard, with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/NFTGallery.tsx: Authenticated NFT gallery page with tabs for all NFTs and issued NFTs, collection filtering, mint modal, detail modal, and wallet/principal display.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: NFT upload/mint page with a form for title, description, price, collection selection, and image upload with progress tracking, requiring Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/utils/blogHelpers.ts: Utility functions to merge static and backend blog posts into a unified sorted list, find a post by ID, and format timestamps as German-locale dates.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Async helper that copies text to the clipboard using the Clipboard API with a textarea execCommand fallback for older browsers.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Utility functions to shorten or format an ICP principal string for display, truncating the middle with ellipsis.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations, while enabling dark mode and the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the current project state (version 3) for a fix request targeting the Admin button's infinite grey/loading state on the live site, listing three existing fix features related to actor initialisation, admin role detection hooks, and Navigation component error handling.
